This recruitment is separate from the 95 HK vacancies. The prescribed qualification is PUC/Class 12 or an accepted equivalent. Applications begin on 23 November 2026. The application deadline is 22 December 2026. The fee payment deadline is 23 December 2026. The general minimum age is 18 years. The maximum age varies from 32 to 37 years according to category. The starting basic pay is Rs. 37,500. The maximum basic pay is Rs. 76,100. Candidates must meet the prescribed physical measurements. Physical Endurance and Physical Efficiency Tests are qualifying stages. The written examination consists of 100 questions carrying 100 marks. Mathematics carries 40 marks. PUC marks and written examination marks receive 50% weightage each in final merit calculation. Original certificate verification is mandatory. Eligible candidates must possess prescribed reservation certificates. The induction training period is nine months. The probation period is 36 months, including training. Applicants must regularly check official websites for updates.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Beat Forester Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Karnataka Forest Department has published the detailed notification dated 17 November 2026 under reference KFD/HOFF/B9(RCT)/8/2026-PnR-KFD for recruitment of 355 Beat Forester (Forest Guard) Group C posts in the Residual Parent Cadre. The 46-page Kannada notification includes regular and backlog vacancies, circle-wise reservation, educational qualifications, age limits, application fees, physical test standards, written examination pattern and selection instructions. Official Notification PDF: Download Karnataka Beat Forester 355 RPC Notification 2026

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Beat Forester Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The Karnataka Forest Department has announced the application schedule for all 355 RPC/Non-HK Beat Forester positions. Important: The online application deadline and fee payment deadline are different. Candidates must submit their applications by 22 December 2026 and complete the applicable fee payment by 23 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Forest Guard Vacancy 2026 - 355 Posts
content_sections.text: The Karnataka Forest Department has announced 355 positions under the Residual Parent Cadre. These include 320 regular vacancies and 35 backlog vacancies remaining from the earlier recruitment process. The notification also contains separate category-wise and division-wise reservation tables for all 35 backlog vacancies. Applicants claiming backlog reservation must verify the applicable eligibility conditions and vacancy allocation in the official PDF.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Beat Forester Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the educational qualification, age limit, physical standards and applicable reservation requirements. Candidates must have passed PUC (Pre-University Course / Class 12) from a recognized board or possess an equivalent qualification accepted under the Karnataka recruitment rules. Important: Candidates possessing vocational or other alternative qualifications should check the equivalence conditions in the notification. Class 10 alone is not sufficient for Beat Forester recruitment. Yes. Candidates who have passed PUC or an equivalent Class 12 examination can apply if they meet the prescribed age, physical fitness and other eligibility requirements. The notification does not prescribe a general previous employment experience requirement for ordinary Beat Forester applicants. Selection depends on educational eligibility, qualifying physical tests, examination performance and other recruitment conditions.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Beat Forester Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The recruitment process includes academic shortlisting, physical fitness assessment, written examination and verification of documents. Online application submission and eligibility scrutiny. Shortlisting based on PUC or equivalent examination marks. Physical Standard Test (PST). Physical Endurance Test. Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Written examination. Preparation of the merit list. Verification of original documents and applicable certificates. Medical assessment and final appointment formalities. Candidates are shortlisted for the physical stages in the prescribed 1:20 ratio , based on academic marks and applicable recruitment conditions. Applicants must qualify in the prescribed physical tests to proceed further in the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Beat Forester Physical Standard Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the prescribed physical measurements before participating in further physical tests. The notification provides relaxed standards for specified eligible Scheduled Tribe local forest-dweller candidates. Important: Relaxed physical standards are available only to candidates satisfying the specific notified local forest-dweller conditions and certificate requirements. They do not automatically apply to every ST candidate. Candidates must satisfy the eyesight standards specified in Section 7 of the notification. The prescribed distance vision standards include 6/6 in the better eye and 6/9 in the other eye , subject to the complete medical rules and conditions. Candidates should review the near-vision requirements and other eyesight conditions in the official notification. The notification identifies certain physical and medical conditions that may disqualify candidates, including: Knock knees. Bow legs. Flat feet. Varicose veins. Specified speech and hearing impairments. Disqualifying eyesight conditions, including colour blindness or night blindness. Other medical conditions identified in the recruitment rules. Candidates must satisfy the prescribed hearing, vision and overall medical fitness standards. The detailed physical and medical criteria appear on pages 26 to 28 of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Beat Forester Physical Endurance Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the physical measurements must qualify in the prescribed running test. Important: Candidates must meet the applicable time limit. The Physical Endurance Test is qualifying in nature.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Beat Forester Physical Efficiency Test 2026
content_sections.text: The Physical Efficiency Test includes speed, jumping, shot put and running events. Candidates must qualify in at least three of the five events , subject to the detailed physical efficiency conditions.

content_sections.text: Candidates who qualify in the applicable physical tests will be considered for the written examination conducted through the Karnataka Examinations Authority.
